geometry: 77 cylinders, 2 heads, 8 sectors, 1024 bytes per sector
provenance: Original source; no DOS, commercial ROM, guest binary or copied emulator implementation
contract: Establish mode-4 high OUT before PIC initialization to drain setup requests; twice arm count 60000, write replacement LSB and delay while old count remains 58000..59999, complete count 2000 through opposite bank and latch active count 1900..2000; both port banks and cross-bank reads/writes; bounded 6000-iteration IRQ wait, exactly one natural IRQ0 per arming with ISR=1, normal EOI, ISR=0, IRET; latched post-terminal counts 60000..65534 separated by 500 LOOP instructions advance by 900..1100; 40000 LOOP quiet interval (>65536 PIT clocks) per arm with no extra IRQ and IRR0=ISR0=0
host: Boot, step and read only; no input, IRQ injection or result writes
guards: All a5 bytes in result_hex must remain unchanged; guest and host compare all 32 bytes
result_layout: 8000 guard; 8001 total IRQ0 entries=2; 8002/8003 ISR entry=1/1; 8004/8005 post-EOI=0/0; 8006/8007 advancing post-terminal counts=1/1; 8008/8009 quiet full wrap=1/1; 800a/800b partial replacement preserves count=1/1; 800c/800d completed replacement loaded=1/1; 800e..801f guards=a5
reset: Same image, results and budget before and after Machine reset
